note: Order is teaching order. id = Unicode name suffix (ARABIC LETTER <ID>). joins: dual = connects both sides (4 forms); right = connects only to the letter before it (2 forms). family = letters sharing a skeleton, told apart by dots.

letters.name: أَلِف
letters.hint: Long 'a' as in 'father'. Never connects to the letter after it.

letters.name: بَاء
letters.hint: Like English 'b'. One dot below.

letters.name: تَاء
letters.hint: Like English 't'. Two dots above.

letters.name: ثَاء
letters.hint: Like 'th' in 'think'. Three dots above.

letters.name: جِيم
letters.hint: Like 'j' in 'jam'. One dot inside the curve.

letters.name: حَاء
letters.hint: A breathy 'h' from deep in the throat, like fogging a mirror. No dot.

letters.name: خَاء
letters.hint: Like 'ch' in Scottish 'loch'. One dot above.

letters.name: دَال
letters.hint: Like English 'd'. Never connects to the letter after it.

letters.name: ذَال
letters.hint: Like 'th' in 'this'. Same shape as dāl plus a dot above.

letters.name: رَاء
letters.hint: A quick rolled or tapped 'r'. Never connects to the letter after it.

letters.name: زَاي
letters.hint: Like English 'z'. Same shape as rāʾ plus a dot above.

letters.name: سِين
letters.hint: Like English 's'. Three small teeth, no dots.

letters.name: شِين
letters.hint: Like 'sh' in 'ship'. Same shape as sīn plus three dots above.

letters.name: صَاد
letters.hint: A heavy, deep 's' with the tongue pulled back. No dot.

letters.name: ضَاد
letters.hint: A heavy, deep 'd'. Same shape as ṣād plus a dot above.

letters.name: طَاء
letters.hint: A heavy, deep 't'. A loop with a tall stem.

letters.name: ظَاء
letters.hint: A heavy 'th' as in 'this'. Same shape as ṭāʾ plus a dot above.

letters.name: عَيْن
letters.hint: A voiced squeeze deep in the throat. No English equivalent, so lean on the audio.

letters.name: غَيْن
letters.hint: A gargled sound, like a French 'r'. Same shape as ʿayn plus a dot above.

letters.name: فَاء
letters.hint: Like English 'f'. One dot above.

letters.name: قَاف
letters.hint: A 'k' made much further back in the throat. Two dots above.

letters.name: كَاف
letters.hint: Like English 'k'.

letters.name: لَام
letters.hint: Like English 'l'. A tall stem.

letters.name: مِيم
letters.hint: Like English 'm'. A small closed loop.

letters.name: نُون
letters.hint: Like English 'n'. One dot above.

letters.name: هَاء
letters.hint: Like English 'h', always pronounced. Its shape changes a lot between positions.

letters.name: وَاو
letters.hint: 'w' as a consonant, or long 'oo' as in 'moon'. Never connects to the letter after it.

letters.name: يَاء
letters.hint: 'y' as a consonant, or long 'ee' as in 'see'. Two dots below.
